narration_full: Meet the wolverine frog. When attacked, this creature does something straight out of a horror movie. Fact one: It deliberately breaks the bones in its own toes, forcing the jagged bone shards to puncture through its skin pads to create razor-sharp combat claws. Fact two: Once the predator retreats, its muscles relax, the bone claws retract inside, and the torn tissue completely regenerates within days. Fact three: During breeding season, males grow hair-like filaments that absorb extra oxygen from water, letting them guard underwater nests for weeks.
